$description: Design tokens of the Battle Studio symbol pipeline. Leaves are { $value, $type, $description } (the shape of the W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft, not validated against its tooling). Lengths are CSS px at 1x (u): the pipeline renders every symbol at 1x, 2x and 3x from these numbers. Edit a value, run `node build.mjs`, look at sheets/. Override a few tokens without editing this file: `node build.mjs --tokens my-overrides.json` (same tree, only the leaves you change).

standard.$description: The default palette: tested for WCAG 2.x contrast and for protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and greyscale (results/colour-tests.json, sheets/cvd-*.png).

union.$description: Union plate. Deep blue: white ink 8.6:1, luminance 1.8x lower than the Confederate plate so the two sides also differ in greyscale.

confederate.$description: Confederate plate. Brick vermilion (Okabe-Ito family): white ink 4.7:1. Chosen against blue so every simulated deficiency keeps a CIEDE2000 distance above 40.

unknown.$description: Side unknown / contested (the 10 ids whose state code contradicts the prefix). Gold, NATO's colour for 'unknown'; never a side colour.

inkOnUnknown.$description: Glyph ink on the contested gold plate (dark, 9:1).

ink.$description: Glyph ink on the two army plates.

bone.$description: The light ring around every plate (the inner ring of the dual ring). Reads on forest, shadow and mid-tone fields.

keyline.$description: The dark ring around every plate (the outer ring) and the shadow colour. Reads on pale fields, bare soil and paper.

chip.$description: Fill of the small status chips (posture, arm state, identity from the id alone).

carriedGrey.$description: The grey a carried-forward plate is mixed toward.

highContrast.$description: Darker plates and a brighter ink for the high-contrast variant (build.mjs --palette highContrast).

inkOnUnknown.$description: Glyph ink on the contested plate.

ink.$description: Glyph ink on the army plates, high contrast.

keyline.$description: Dark ring (outer ring and shadow), high contrast.

chip.$description: Fill of the status chips, high contrast.

light.$description: Width (u) of the light ring outside the plate edge.

dark.$description: Width (u) of the dark ring outside the light ring.

dy.$description: Soft contact shadow: vertical offset (u). 0 blur or 0 alpha switches it off.

lift.$description: How much lighter the top of a plate is than its bottom (0 = flat, 0.15 = strong). A hint of top light is the only depth a plate has.

battery.$description: Plate size multiplier of a battery (company-sized). The base unit of the map.

regiment.$description: Plate size multiplier of a regiment.

army.$description: Army (never placed in the current data).

mix.$description: How far a carried-forward plate is mixed toward carriedGrey (0..1).

ringDash.$description: Dash pattern (u) of the light ring of a carried-forward plate. Dotted, not dashed: it recedes.

glyphOpacity.$description: Opacity of the glyph on a carried-forward plate.

size.$description: Diameter (u) of a status chip (posture, arm state, identity from the id alone).

stroke.$description: Stroke width (u) of the chip glyphs.

clearance.$description: Gap (u) kept between the chip body and the arm glyph ink box and the echelon marks: the chip is a corner badge and never covers either.

maxCoverage.$description: The largest share (0..1) of a symbol's silhouette the status chip may cover. The chip sits at the closest corner position that satisfies this and the clearance: a badge on the symbol, never a lid over it.

segW.$description: Width (u) of one of the four gauge segments.

gap.$description: Gap (u) between the plate's own ring and the selection ring.

stroke.$description: Width (u) of the selection ring (bone, between two dark keylines).

keyline.$description: Dark keyline (u) on both sides of the ring.

glow.$description: Blur (u) of an optional soft glow behind the ring (0 = none).

keyline.$description: Dark keyline (u) around the hover ring.

glow.$description: Blur (u) of the soft glow behind the hover ring.

tab.$description: The label tab: a pill that tucks behind a symbol and carries its name as runtime text, so a tile is one object, not a plate plus a separate caption chip.

h.$description: Tab height (u). Room for 11.5 px text with 3 u above and below.

radius.$description: Corner radius (u); half the height = a full pill.

capExtra.$description: Straight run (u) added to each end cap so the end slices contain no part of the stretched middle.

tuck.$description: How far (u) the tab's left end tucks behind the symbol's edge.

padX.$description: Text padding (u) from the end of the cap to the first letter.

font.$description: CSS font of the tab text. 11.5 px semibold: legible without being loud.

fill.$description: Dark glass tab fill (for aerial and dark grounds).

offset.$description: Offset (u) of each back plate of an aggregate mark (up and to the left).

backTint.$description: How much darker each back plate is than the one in front (0..1).

glyphGap.$description: Gap (u) between the arm glyphs in the row on an aggregate plate.

glyphMax.$description: Largest size (u) of an arm glyph in that row.

font.$description: CSS font of the count text (×N) the skin draws into the count slot of an aggregate mark. 12px bold: the slot is sized for three characters.

w.$description: Aggregate plate width (u), NATO-spirit. A rectangle for both sides: the row of arm glyphs needs the room.

size.$description: Reference size (u) of a Union corps badge.

nato.$description: Language (a): NATO-spirit frames. Conventions: APP-6 / MIL-STD-2525 frame shapes, saltire / slash / dot icons and echelon marks above the frame; adapted here to flat, modern plates.

w.$description: Frame width (u) of a base unit (regiment, battery). 3:2 like the land-unit frame.

h.$description: Frame height (u) of a base unit.

radius.$description: Corner radius (u). NATO frames are square; a small radius keeps the plate calm at 1x.

confederate.$description: Confederate frame shape: diamond (NATO 'hostile') or rect. Shape repeats the colour so the sides differ without colour. An adaptation: NATO means 'hostile to the observer'; here it only means 'the other army'.

mixed.$description: Aggregate of both sides: split rectangle (invented here).

diag.$description: Full diagonal (u) of a base-unit diamond; scales with the echelon.

stroke.$description: Stroke width (u) of the arm glyph.

inset.$description: Gap (u) between the glyph ends and the frame edge.

dot.$description: Radius (u) of the artillery dot at base size.

mode.$description: How a formation (brigade, division, corps: no arm in the data) is drawn inside its frame: inner = a thin inset outline (a container), none = the empty NATO 'unspecified' frame.

inset.$description: Gap (u) between the frame edge and the inner outline.

stroke.$description: Stroke width (u) of the inner outline.

base.$description: Draw the mark of the base echelons (battery I, regiment III) too, as NATO does. false = base units carry no mark.

stroke.$description: Stroke width (u) of an echelon mark.

pitch.$description: Distance (u) between the bars of I, II, III.

xSize.$description: Width (u) of one X of brigade / division / corps / army.

gap.$description: Gap (u) between the ring of the frame and the echelon mark.

keyline.$description: Light halo (u) around the dark echelon mark (the mark is dark, the halo light, like a map label).

shield.$description: Language (b): flat pictograms in a rounded shield. Pictograms are invented here (chevron, horse head, gun wheel, target, three dots); only the echelon marks are NATO.

w.$description: Shield width (u) of a base unit (regiment, battery).

h.$description: Shield height (u) of a base unit.

cornerRadius.$description: Radius (u) of the two top corners.

shoulder.$description: Fraction of the height at which the straight sides end and the taper to the point begins.

taperA.$description: Shape of the taper: first control handle (fraction of the taper height).

taperB.$description: Shape of the taper: second control handle (fraction of the taper height).

tipRound.$description: Half width (u) of the soft tip.

glyphDy.$description: Vertical shift (u) of the pictogram (the body is wider above the middle than below).

battery.$description: Shield size multiplier of a battery.

base.$description: Draw marks on the base echelons (battery, regiment) too. false = the base unit carries none: it is the unit of account and the most numerous tile.

band.$description: Height (u) of the header band that carries the echelon marks, at base size.

bandSink.$description: How much darker than the plate the band is (0..1).

bandUnknown.$description: Header band colour of a contested (unknown side) shield: a deep amber, because darkening the gold toward black turns it olive.

minimal.$description: Language (c): minimal glyphs for editorial maps. circle = infantry, triangle = cavalry, square = artillery, rotated square = horse artillery, hexagon = formation. All invented here; nothing is NATO.

size.$description: Reference diameter (u) of a base unit marker (regiment, battery). 16 u: large enough that a 15 u status chip is a corner badge and not a lid, small enough to stay the quietest of the three languages.

cornerRadius.$description: Corner radius (u) of triangle, square, diamond and hexagon.

triangle.$description: Triangle side as a multiple of the reference diameter (area close to the circle's).

square.$description: Square side as a multiple of the reference diameter.

diamond.$description: Diamond (horse artillery) diagonal as a multiple of the reference diameter.

dot.$description: Sharpshooter centre dot radius as a multiple of the reference diameter.

battery.$description: Marker size multiplier of a battery.

first.$description: Gap (u) between the hexagon edge and the first nested outline.

pitch.$description: Gap (u) between nested outlines. Their number is the echelon: brigade 1, division 2, corps 3, army 4.

stroke.$description: Stroke width (u) of the nested outlines.

pin.$description: The pin: a small ground mark at a unit's true position when its tile has been moved off it to avoid overlap, joined to the tile by the leader line. Pre-rendered per side (it carries the side colour) so it can never look like a stray dot.

radius.$description: Radius (u) of the pin's coloured centre.

ring.$description: Width (u) of the pin's bone ring around the centre (a dark keyline follows from ring.dark).

leader.$description: The leader line from a pin to its displaced tile. Drawn at runtime (a line has no fixed length) from these numbers by runtime/atlas.mjs drawLeader: a dark underlay, then a bone line, round caps, so it reads on every backdrop and matches the rings.

keyline.$description: Extra width (u) of the dark underlay on each side of the bone line.

alpha.$description: Opacity of the whole leader (bone line and its underlay).

minLength.$description: A tile moved less than this many u gets no leader and no pin: it is still on its position for every practical purpose.
